description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rendclaw Trow.
When Rendclaw Trow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rendclaw Trow.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
